analysis.title: VZ 3Q'26: First Take
key_insights: Verizon 3Q26 mobility and broadband revenue grew +2.9% y/y to $23.49B, in line with estimate and consensus ($23.5B). Total revenue was $34.31B vs est/cons $34.8B, a miss driven by lower equipment revenue of $5.11B (est/cons $5.5B).

Adj. EBITDA was $13.80B vs est/cons $13.7B, a 40.2% margin. Adj. diluted EPS was $1.31 vs Wolfe est $1.25 and consensus $1.27, excluding $0.27B of after-tax charges for amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and acquisition and integration costs.

Adj. FCF was $7.80B vs Wolfe est $6.6B and consensus $6.2B, on CFFO of $11.52B (est $10.7B, cons $10.2B) and capex of $3.72B (est/cons $4.0B). $4.0B has been repurchased YTD vs the $4.5B full-year expectation.

Management raised 2026 guidance across the board: postpaid phone net adds to +1.1-1.2M (prev. upper half of +0.75-1.0M), Mobility & Broadband service revenue growth to the upper half of +2.5-3.0% y/y, adj. diluted EPS to $5.04-5.06 (prev. $4.99-5.04), and FCF approaching $22.5B (prev. $21.9-22.1B). Repurchases are maintained at $4.5B.
Postpaid phone net adds were +406K vs est +215K and cons +209K, driven by underlying gross adds growth of +13.2% y/y (cons +2.7%). Churn fell 4bps y/y to 0.94% (est 0.92%, cons 0.93%).
Postpaid accounts added were +137K (est +59K, cons +51K), but postpaid ARPA fell -1.9% y/y to $168.08/mo, worse than est $169.90 and cons $170.73.
Prepaid core excluding SafeLink lost -12K subscribers (est +43K, cons +4K), while prepaid core ARPU grew +2.5% y/y to $33.51/mo (est $33.35, cons $32.88).
Broadband missed: Fios/fiber net adds were +155K (est +180K, cons +168K) and FWA (fixed wireless access) net adds worsened further to +159K (est +200K, cons +194K).

market_movers.rationale: Wolfe keeps Peer Perform on Verizon (priced $44.66 as of 10/23/26) after a 3Q print with beats on EPS, FCF and postpaid phone adds and misses on broadband net adds and total revenue. Wolfe does not assign price targets to Peer Perform names.

earnings_insights: VZ 3Q26 (reported 10/26/26): adj. diluted EPS $1.31 vs Wolfe est $1.25 and consensus $1.27, excluding $0.27B after-tax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and acquisition and integration charges.
VZ 3Q26 total revenue $34.31B reported vs est/cons $34.8B. Mobility and broadband revenue $23.49B vs est/cons $23.5B. Equipment revenue $5.11B vs est/cons $5.5B.
VZ 3Q26 adj. EBITDA $13.80B reported vs est/cons $13.7B, 40.2% margin. Adj. FCF $7.80B reported vs est $6.6B and cons $6.2B.

VZ 2026 guidance raised: adj. diluted EPS $5.04-5.06 (prev. $4.99-5.04), FCF approaching $22.5B (prev. $21.9-22.1B), postpaid phone net adds +1.1-1.2M, Mobility & Broadband service revenue growth in the upper half of +2.5-3.0% y/y. Repurchases maintained at $4.5B, with $4.0B done YTD.
risk_factors: Downside risks named by Wolfe: cable mobile players using rising scale to renegotiate MVNO pricing or move more of their mobile data off Verizon's network, higher medium/long-term capital intensity from fast FWA growth, peers using pricing and promotions more aggressively, tax law changes, and a worse than expected impact from lead-sheathed cables on brand and financials.

Upside risks named by Wolfe: Verizon gains postpaid phone subscribers with less promotional intensity, fiber builds are cheaper, faster and more accretive than expected, and cost savings drive greater EBITDA and FCF growth.
